# Meta Description

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Meta Description

A meta description provides a brief summary of the webpage's content. For example,

```html
<head>
  <title>HTML Lists</title>

  <meta name="description" content="In this tutorial, you will learn to create HTML lists: unordered lists and ordered lists.">

</head>
```

Here, we have set the name attribute of the <meta> tag to description.

Search engines such as Google may use meta descriptions as snippets in search results.

![Use of meta descriptions in Google.](data:image/png;base64,)
